summary: Governance/planning/bootstrap hygiene phase only -- no Runtime Context implementation, runtime execution, persistence implementation, or execution capability introduced. Repaired tasks/TODO.md, which had presented a stale 90-series roadmap as current work long after the 107-112-series arc superseded it: the former table is now clearly relabeled Historical: Production v1 Path (90-series, superseded), and a new Current Roadmap (112-series) table lists 112A/112B/112B.1 complete with 112C confirmed as next (112D/112E/113A marked explicit tentative candidates, not a committed queue). Corrected the premise that pcae session bootstrap already detected this staleness -- direct inspection of src/pcae/core/context.py and src/pcae/commands/session.py found it never read tasks/TODO.md at all; the prior stale TODO observation was a human/agent-level inference, not tool behavior. Hardened pcae session bootstrap --compact: it now prints an explicit Recommended next phase: line (extracted from PROJECT_STATUS.md's own inline Recommended next repo phase sentence, previously computed internally for the non-compact path only and never surfaced in the compact path every profile-based bootstrap actually uses) and an explicit Planning note: line comparing tasks/TODO.md's own next-phase marker against the current phase, stating plainly which source is authoritative and why the other was ignored when they disagree. Added one new operational rule to CONTEXT_PACK_OPERATIONAL_RULES stating the precedence directly. Documented a full source-of-truth precedence order (active task contract, phase prompt, PROJECT_STATUS.md, canonical roadmap docs, tasks/TODO.md, tasks/DONE.md, stale handoff snippets) in new docs/PHASE_112_PLANNING_BOOTSTRAP_CONSISTENCY_HARDENING.md. Noted, as an explicit limitation rather than silently repeating it: docs/ROADMAP.md's own Current State section is similarly stale (still describes 90 phases, 90B complete) but a full refresh is out of this phase's scope. 18 new tests (tests/test_bootstrap_todo_consistency.py). Focused tests (413), governance/autonomy group (2609), and the full release/lifecycle regression suite including the two known-slow phase85/phase87 integration files (1497/1497) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline).
